entries.name: Ajv
entries.use_for: Fastest JSON Schema validator for Node.js and browsers
entries.why: The reference JSON Schema validator in JS; used across OpenAPI and config tooling

entries.name: ArkType
entries.use_for: TypeScript's 1:1 validator with syntax that mirrors TS types
entries.why: Very fast runtime validation with type-level parsing; supports Standard Schema

entries.name: AutoForm
entries.use_for: Render complete React forms automatically from an existing Zod or other schema.
entries.why: Generates forms from schemas with shadcn/ui and other UI adapters, saving boilerplate for admin and CRUD forms.

entries.name: class-validator
entries.use_for: Decorator-based validation for TypeScript classes
entries.why: The validation layer used by NestJS DTOs
entries.stable_reason: Feature-complete decorator validation library; stable API that NestJS relies on

entries.name: Conform
entries.use_for: Build forms that work without JavaScript and validate on server and client.
entries.why: Designed for Remix/Next.js server actions; progressive enhancement with Zod or Valibot schemas.

entries.name: Flutter Form Builder
entries.use_for: Build forms with validation and many ready input fields in Flutter.
entries.why: The most used Flutter form package, reducing boilerplate for field state, validation and value collection.

entries.name: Formik
entries.use_for: Build forms in React without tears
entries.why: One of the most used React form libraries; common in existing codebases
entries.stable_reason: Mature, feature-complete React form library in maintenance mode; API unchanged for years and still widely downloaded

entries.name: Joi
entries.use_for: Powerful schema description language and data validator for JavaScript
entries.why: The classic Node.js validation library, widely used for API input validation

entries.name: Pydantic
entries.use_for: Validate and parse data in Python using type hints.
entries.why: The standard Python validation library (Rust core), used by FastAPI and most LLM tooling.

entries.name: React Hook Form
entries.use_for: Manage React form state and validation with minimal re-renders.
entries.why: The most used React form library; uncontrolled inputs keep it fast and resolvers plug in Zod, Yup or Valibot.

entries.name: react-jsonschema-form
entries.use_for: Generate React forms from JSON Schema with themes for MUI, Ant, Chakra and more
entries.why: Standard way to render forms from JSON Schema; many UI themes

entries.name: Superforms
entries.use_for: Handle forms with server and client validation in SvelteKit.
entries.why: The de facto SvelteKit form library, supporting many validators and progressive enhancement.

entries.name: TanStack Form
entries.use_for: Build fully type-safe forms in React, Vue, Solid, Angular or Lit.
entries.why: Headless, deeply typed form state with standard-schema validation and adapters for many frameworks.

entries.name: TypeBox
entries.use_for: JSON Schema type builder with static TypeScript type resolution
entries.why: Generates standard JSON Schema with TS types; used by Fastify and Elysia

entries.name: Valibot
entries.use_for: Validate data with a modular, tree-shakable schema library when bundle size matters.
entries.why: Zod-like type safety with a functional API that tree-shakes down to a few hundred bytes.

entries.name: validator
entries.use_for: Go struct and field validation via tags
entries.why: The de facto Go validation library, used by Gin and many APIs

entries.name: VeeValidate
entries.use_for: Form validation for Vue with Zod/Yup/Valibot schema support
entries.why: The leading Vue form library with composition API and schema integrations
entries.stable_reason: Mature v4 Vue form library with a settled API; releases are infrequent because it is feature-complete

entries.name: Vest
entries.use_for: Write form validation as test-like suites, independent of UI framework.
entries.why: Unit-test-style syntax for complex, async and conditional validation that stays readable.

entries.name: Yup
entries.use_for: Schema builder for runtime value parsing and validation
entries.why: Long-time default schema validator for Formik and many React form setups

entries.name: Zod
entries.use_for: Validate data at runtime with schemas that also give you static TypeScript types.
entries.why: The most adopted TS schema library; integrates with tRPC, react-hook-form, AI SDKs and many frameworks.
